issues.reason: Compound concepts legislates the possessor/whole + part/component case explicitly and bars fusion ('never car_engine'); 'the cliff base' is the base of a cliff, exactly the table-leg shape, so the fused kind and its genus atom are emitted where the rule licenses none.
The same fusion leaves the cliff - a referent the phrase names - with no symbol and no typing, and omits the PartOf link the rule requires.

During takes two reified eventualities, but molting_week is a kind symbol (its only other atom is the genus (Inheritance molting_week week)), so a class occupies an individual/eventuality slot and no witness of that kind is ever typed.

gaps_confirmed: A recurring temporal frame expressed as a bare-plural NP ('during molting weeks') inside a habitual clause: During demands a reified outer eventuality, and the bare-plural rules yield only an episodic group witness or a non-specific kind filler, neither of which is one.
defect_summary: 'The cliff base' must be (Member sk_base_1 base) (PartOf sk_base_1 sk_cliff_1) (Member sk_cliff_1 cliff), with the walk's Theme on the base witness and no cliff_base symbol or genus; that same route also supplies the cliff typing the parse omits. For 'during molting weeks' the instruction set licenses NO compliant form - During requires an eventuality, nothing individuates a bare-plural recurring frame, and Time/Every/TimesPer take only calendar slots, periods or rates - so the conjunct should have been left out and the gap recorded.
notes: The 'each morning' handling is exactly right - (Time sk_walk_1 morning) plus the implied cycle (Every sk_walk_1 1 day), no tense atom and no companion - as is the Theme role and leaving molting_week's noun modifier unexposed.
